title: Research notes: Sassafras Ridge (15Fu3)
summary: Sources for the Mississippian mound center at Sassafras Ridge. The location is address-restricted; the pin is rounded to 0.1°. Several brief details could not be checked and were cut.

items.text: NRHP-listed (information potential); address restricted; periods of significance AD 0–1499.
Studied with Adams and Wickliffe in R. Barry Lewis’s 1986 Kentucky Heritage Council report.
One of several Mississippian mound centers in Fulton and bordering counties; 2019 NAGPRA notice found no cultural affiliation with a present-day tribe.
Mound count, ceramic types and owl-effigy fragment: only in a thesis that could not be loaded, so cut.
Exact location details in the federal notice are not repeated here.

openQuestions: A loadable public source for the mound count and ceramics.

sources.citation: “Sassafras Ridge (Site 15 FU 3),” NRIS 84000285, NPGallery, National Park Service.
